name: AI Builder
author: BlockDesigner
description: Builds and edits structures from a chat or a reference picture: "build a small castle", "add a tower on the east side". Runs a local model on your own PC by default (downloaded from its Models page), or your own local server, or your own Claude or OpenAI key. Also adds /setblock, /fill and builder commands such as /tower, /roof and /battlements to BlockEdit.
